rows.heading: # VisualCore — new Mac setup and session handoff
rows.note: One-time move of the build machine to the Mac Studio, completed: A04-P02 and A04-P03 were sealed there afterwards. The guide continues as the revised setup.md, which keeps the owner-only marker.

rows.heading: ## 1. Reference toolchain (must match)
rows.note: Pins (Xcode 27.2 27B52, SDK 27.2, Swift 6.4.2, XcodeGen 2.46.0, CMake 4.4.5, Python >= 3.10, iOS 27.2 and 26.5 runtimes) are in Configs/toolchain.json and checked by this script; sealed in F00 (environment-F00.json).

rows.heading: ## 2. Accounts and apps (👤 owner)
rows.note: Owner-only steps, evidently done on the Mac Studio (Xcode 27.2 runs, Desktop session active); no sealed check covers them. Whether the developer account (step 4, devices only) was added is unknown: open under OD-06.

rows.heading: ## 3. Command-line tools
rows.note: Header only. The tools of 3.1-3.3 were installed on the Mac Studio: verify_environment.py printed PASS there (baseline section 4) and the sealed A04-P02 and A04-P03 run-checks used them. 3.4 and 3.5 have their own rows.

rows.heading: ### 3.1 Homebrew
rows.note: Machine-only step, done on the Mac Studio (the sealed A04-P02 and A04-P03 checks ran with Homebrew's python3, cmake and xcodegen); no sealed check names Homebrew itself. The step continues in setup.md.

rows.heading: ### 3.2 Packages
rows.note: brew install python@3.15 uv gh git-lfs cmake xcodegen; python3 must be Homebrew's (>= 3.10; never replace /usr/bin/python3). Python, CMake and XcodeGen are checked by verify_environment.py (F00); gh, uv, git-lfs are not.

rows.heading: ### 3.3 Pin XcodeGen 2.46.0 and CMake 4.4.5 if Homebrew installed other versions
rows.note: Pins are enforced by Configs/toolchain.json and verify_environment.py (F00): install the XcodeGen 2.46.0 release binary or CMake 4.4.5 instead of a newer Homebrew version; never upgrade silently (constitution).

rows.heading: ### 3.4 Spec Kit CLI (optional)
rows.note: Rule to carry: never re-run 'specify init' here. The nine skills (.claude/skills/speckit-*) and .specify/ are committed, so the CLI (uv tool, 1.4.1.dev0) only inspects or upgrades. The install steps stay in setup.md.

rows.heading: ### 3.5 GitHub sign-in (👤 owner)
rows.note: Owner-only gh auth, evidently done on the Mac Studio (A04-P02 and A04-P03 commits reached origin/main before the baseline); no sealed check. Git rules kept (AC-24): owner's email, LF, no trailers. Pushing: D-13.

rows.heading: ## 4. Simulator runtimes
rows.note: iOS 27.2 and 26.5 runtimes are on the Mac Studio (verify_environment.py PASS, baseline section 4); both ran the sealed A04-P02 and A04-P03 simulator checks. Kept: choose simulators by runtime, never by an old UDID.

rows.heading: ## 5. Clone the repository and its submodules
rows.note: Pins d93edd1 (projectm-ios), c88894e (engine), 29d1823 (ANGLE), 22fb0cf (projectm-eval) and five shallow preset packs match the baseline; F07 is sealed at d93edd1 (ADR-0005). Kept: no --recursive at top level (gclient).

rows.heading: ## 6. Build the reference engine binaries (one time, network, about 12 GB, roughly an hour)
rows.note: ANGLEFrameworks and ProjectM.xcframework exist on the Mac Studio (baseline section 3); the 7-step reference regression passed in the sealed A04-P02 (t216) and A04-P03 (t314) checks. Kept: never clean Vendor/angle.

rows.heading: ## 7. Recreate the local ledger state
rows.note: bootstrap, validate and status were run on the Mac Studio (validate sealed in F01). The expected status (33 pass, next A04-P02) is stale: 35 pass, next A04-P04. bootstrap now reads the archived README; logs stay per Mac.
